await run('old-future-mismatch-and-corrupt-file-rejection',async()=>{await (await reveal09(p.locator('#editorModecode09'))).click();await (await reveal09(p.locator('#codeEditor'))).fill('点数を71にする。');await p.waitForTimeout(350);await (await reveal09(p.locator('#editorModeblocks09'))).click();const before=await state(),original=L.read(saved);const files=[['old08',original.replaceAll('AKARI09-DATA','AKARI08-DATA').replaceAll('"0.9"','"0.8"')],['old07',original.replaceAll('AKARI09-DATA','AKARI07-DATA').replaceAll('"0.9"','"0.7"')],['future',original.replaceAll('"0.9"','"0.10"')],['mismatch',original.replace('"languageVersion": "0.9"','"languageVersion": "0.8"')],['body-tamper',original.replace('# あかり 0.9 の作品','# 改変')],['corrupt-payload',original.replace('"schema": "akari-project"','"schema": BAD')]],evidence=[];
 const codes={old08:'F502',old07:'F502',future:'F501',mismatch:'F501','body-tamper':'F512','corrupt-payload':'F502'};for(const[id,text]of files){const file=L.path.join(dir,id+'.akari.md');L.fs.writeFileSync(file,text);const logs=await p.locator('#console').textContent();await p.locator('#fileInput').setInputFiles(file);await waitForConsoleAppend(logs,codes[id]);await p.waitForFunction(()=>Akari09.app.editorState09.state==='DESIGN');assert.deepEqual(await state(),before,id);const current=await p.locator('#console').textContent(),diagnostic=current.startsWith(logs)?current.slice(logs.length):current;assert.ok(diagnostic.includes(codes[id]),id+' missing '+codes[id]);evidence.push({id,code:codes[id],diagnostic:diagnostic.slice(-220)});}return{cases:evidence,projectSourceHistoryRedoDirtyPreserved:true};});

browser.originalSource: await run('invalid-syntax-save-and-09-storage-isolation',async()=>{await (await reveal09(p.locator('#editorModecode09'))).click();await (await reveal09(p.locator('#codeEditor'))).fill('もし');await p.waitForTimeout(350);const before=await getProject(),pending=p.waitForEvent('download');await (await reveal09(p.locator('#saveBtn'))).click();const d=await pending,file=L.path.join(dir,'invalid-source.akari.md');await d.saveAs(file);assert.equal(await p.evaluate(t=>Akari09.parseProjectFile(t).then(x=>x.project.scripts.find(s=>s.targetId==='stage'&&s.event==='start').source),L.read(file)),'もし');await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#autosaveState').textContent.includes('済み'));const calls=await p.evaluate(()=>__storageCalls);assert.ok(calls.some(x=>String(x[1]).includes('09')||String(x[1]).includes('v09')));assert.ok(calls.every(x=>!/(?:08|07|v08|v07)/.test(String(x[1]))));await p.reload();await p.locator('#recoveryModal.show').waitFor();await (await reveal09(p.locator('#recoveryRestore'))).click();assert.deepEqual(await getProject(),before);assert.equal(await p.locator('#codeEditor').inputValue(),'もし');return{invalidSyntaxSavedAndRestored:true,calls};});

await run('media-editor-run-and-save-roundtrip',async()=>{await (await reveal09(p.locator('#objectSelect'))).selectOption('stage');await (await reveal09(p.locator('#eventSelect'))).selectOption('start');source='背景を「picture」にする。
「tone」を鳴らし、終わるまで待つ。
「silence」を鳴らし、終わるまで待つ。
「素材完了」と言う。';await (await reveal09(p.locator('#codeEditor'))).fill(source);await p.waitForTimeout(350);const compile=await p.evaluate(()=>Akari09.app.compile().errors);assert.deepEqual(compile,[]);await (await reveal09(p.locator('#editorModeblocks09'))).click();const runConsole=await p.locator('#console').textContent();await (await reveal09(p.locator('#runBtn'))).click();await waitForConsoleAppend(runConsole,'素材完了');await (await reveal09(p.locator('#stopBtn'))).click();projectBefore=await getProject();const pending=p.waitForEvent('download');await (await reveal09(p.locator('#saveBtn'))).click();const download=await pending;saved=L.path.join(dir,'media-saved.akari.md');await download.saveAs(saved);const text=L.read(saved);assert.ok(text.includes('AKARI09-DATA-BEGIN'));assert.ok(!text.includes('blockView'));const loaded=await p.evaluate(t=>Akari09.parseProjectFile(t).then(x=>({project:x.project,assets:[...x.assetStore.snapshotRefs().values()].map(a=>({id:a.id,sha256:a.sha256,byteLength:a.byteLength}))})),text);assert.deepEqual(loaded.project,projectBefore);assert.deepEqual(loaded.assets.sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),assetsBefore.map(a=>({id:a.id,sha256:a.sha256,byteLength:a.byteLength})).sort((a,b)=>a.id.localeCompare(b.id)));await (await reveal09(p.locator('#newBtn'))).click();await p.locator('#fileInput').setInputFiles(saved);await p.waitForFunction(()=>Akari09.app.project.sounds.length===2);assert.deepEqual(await getProject(),projectBefore);return{source,saveBytes:L.fs.statSync(saved).size,download:download.suggestedFilename(),sourceOnly:true,projectAndAssetBytesPreserved:true};});
